#Setup
```{r wd and packages}
for (lib in c('tidyverse','janitor','ggpubr','vegan')) {
    suppressPackageStartupMessages(require(lib, character.only = TRUE))
}
```

#1) Cyanobacteria Relative Abundance Calcuation and Plotting
```{r 1.a Read in the data}
data <- read_csv('feature_table_16S.csv')
taxonomy_16s <- read_tsv('taxonomy_16S.tsv')
metadata <- read_csv('metadata_IFGvSBC.csv') 
```

```{r 1.b dataframe setup for NMDS}
#get the samples less than a threshold of seq count
##set min-sequence count
count_cutoff <- 4000

drop_samples <- data %>%
  select(-ASV_ID) %>% #remove ASV-ID column as it is non-numeric
  colSums() %>% #total counts per sample
  .[. < count_cutoff] %>% #filtering the named numbers by cuttoff
  names() #pulling the names (sample_IDs) of numbers below the threshold set earlier
```

```{r 1.c calcuate relative abundance of Cyanobacteria}
cyano <- data %>%
  left_join(taxonomy_16s) %>%
  select(-ASV_ID, -starts_with(c("Ext","PCR")), -any_of(drop_samples))  %>% #with taxonomy merged 
  pivot_longer(-colnames(taxonomy_16s)[2:8], names_to = "Sample", values_to = "count")  %>% #pivot count columns longer
  group_by(Domain, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Sample) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(collapse = sum(count)) %>% #collapse duplicates per sample
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  mutate(abund = collapse/sum(collapse)) %>% #calculate relative abundance by sample /  column
  filter(Class == 'c__Cyanobacteriia') %>% #filter to photosynthetic cyanobacteria
  left_join(metadata) %>%
  group_by(Domain, Phylum, Class, Order, Family, Genus, Watershed, IFG_SBC) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(relAbund = 100 * mean(abund)) %>% #Average relative abundance across field reps
  mutate(Genus = case_when(
  is.na(Genus) & is.na(Family) & is.na(Order) ~ "Other Cyanobacteria",
  is.na(Genus) & is.na(Family) ~ Order,
  is.na(Genus) ~ Family,
  Genus == 'g__uncultured' & is.na(Family) ~ Order,
  Genus == 'g__uncultured' ~ Family,
  TRUE ~ Genus
)) %>%
  mutate(
    Genus = if_else(
      Genus %in% (
        group_by(., Genus) %>%
          summarise(total = sum(relAbund, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
          arrange(desc(total)) %>%
          slice_head(n = 6) %>%
          pull(Genus)
      ),
      Genus,
      "Other Cyanobacteria"))
```

```{r 1.d re-order factors and custom colors}
cyano$Genus <- factor(cyano$Genus, levels=c(
  "g__Calothrix_KVSF5",
  "g__Chamaesiphon_PCC-7430",
  "g__Pleurocapsa_PCC-7319",
  "g__Tychonema_CCAP_1459-11B",
  "f__Leptolyngbyaceae",
  "Other Cyanobacteria"))

cyano_color <- c("#014636",
                 "#016C59",
                 "#02818A",
                 "#3690C0",
                 "#67A9CF",
                 '#666666')
```


```{r 1.e plot cyanobacterial relative abundance}
cyano_bar <- ggplot(cyano, aes(fill=Genus, y=relAbund, x=IFG_SBC))+
  geom_bar(position="stack", stat="identity")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = cyano_color) +
  facet_grid(~Watershed)+
  labs(x = "", y = "Average Relative Abundance %") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(color = "black",
                                    fill = "NA",
                                    linewidth = 1),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y=element_text(size=8),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.text = element_text(size=8),
        legend.box.spacing = unit(0.45, 'pt'),
        legend.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank())
cyano_bar 
```


#2) Eukaryotic Algae Relative Abundance Calcuation and Plotting
```{r 2.a read in data}
data.18 <- read_csv('feature_table_18s.csv')
taxonomy.18 <- read_csv('taxonomy_18S.csv')
```

```{r 2.b pull samples and taxa to drop}
non.protist <- taxonomy.18 %>%
  filter(Phylum == 'p__Vertebrata' | Class %in% c("c__Insecta", "c__Arachnida") | Domain %in% c("Unassigned", "d__Bacteria", "d__Archaea")) %>%
  pull(ASV_ID)

#get the samples less than a threshold of seq count
##set min-sequence count
count_cutoff <- 10000

drop_samples.18 <- data.18 %>%
  select(-ASV_ID) %>% #remove ASV-ID column as it is non-numeric
  colSums() %>% #total counts per sample
  .[. < count_cutoff] %>% #filtering the named numbers by cuttoff
  names() #pulling the names (sample_IDs) of numbers below the threshold set earlier
```

```{r 2.c df setup and relative abundance calculation}
euk_algae <- data.18 %>%
  left_join(taxonomy.18) %>%
  filter(!ASV_ID %in% non.protist) %>%
  select(-ASV_ID, -starts_with(c("Ext","PCR")), -any_of(drop_samples.18))  %>% #drop asv-id now that taxonomy has been merged, 
  pivot_longer(-colnames(taxonomy.18)[2:8], names_to = "Sample", values_to = "count")  %>% #pivot count columns longer
  group_by(Domain, Phylum, Class, Order, Sample) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(collapse = sum(count)) %>% #collapse duplicates per sample at the class level
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  mutate(abund = collapse/sum(collapse)) %>% #calculate relative abundance by sample /  column
  filter(Phylum %in% c("p__Chlorophyta", "p__Cryptophyceae", "p__Dinoflagellata", "p__Haptophyta", "p__Florideophycidae", "p__Diatomea", "p__Ochrophyta") | Order == "o__Euglenophyceae") %>% #filter to the Algal Phyla and Euglenids to only the photosynthetic order
  left_join(metadata) %>%
  group_by(Domain, Phylum, Class, Order, Watershed, IFG_SBC) %>% 
  dplyr::summarise(relAbund = 100 * mean(abund)) %>% #Average relative abundance across field reps
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Phylum, Class, Watershed, IFG_SBC) %>%
  group_by(Class) %>% 
  mutate(Class = case_when(
  is.na(Class) & is.na(Phylum) ~ "Other",
  is.na(Class) ~ paste("Other", Phylum),
  TRUE ~ Class)) %>%
  mutate(
    Class = if_else(
      Class %in% (
        group_by(., Class) %>%
          summarise(total = sum(relAbund, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
          arrange(desc(total)) %>%
          slice_head(n = 10) %>%
          pull(Class)
      ),
      Class,
      "Other"))

euk_sum <- euk_algae %>%
  group_by(Watershed, IFG_SBC) %>%
  summarise(euk_sum = sum(relAbund))
```

```{r 2.d re-ordering factors and custom color pallete}
  ))

                     "#B26F2C", #Coscinodiscophytina

```

```{r 2.e plot the relative abundance of euk algae}
euk_algae_bar <- ggplot(euk_algae, aes(fill=Class, y=relAbund, x=IFG_SBC))+
  geom_bar(position="stack", stat="identity")+
  facet_grid(~Watershed)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = algae_type_long)+
  scale_x_discrete(guide = guide_axis(angle = 0))+ 
  labs(x = "", y = "Average Relative Abundance %") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(color = "black",
                                    fill = "NA",
                                    linewidth = 1),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y=element_text(size=8),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 8),
        legend.text = element_text(size=8),
        legend.box.spacing = unit(0.45, 'pt'),
        legend.background = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank())

euk_algae_bar 
```

#3Combine the two plots
```{r 3.a combine the plots}
bar.2 <- ggarrange(cyano_bar, euk_algae_bar,
                    align = 'v',
                    ncol = 1, nrow = 2,
                    labels = 'auto')
```

```{r 3.b save the final plot}
ggsave(
  filename="Algae_Bar_Main.pdf",
  plot = bar.2,
  dpi = 600,
  width = 160,
  height = 240,
  units = 'mm'
)
```
